y-m-43-02.title: Ukuhlola isizathu sikaYerin 'njengezinombolo'
y-m-43-02.topic: Ama-matrix amabili umkhiqizo wawo uyi-zero matrix (AB=O)
y-m-43-02.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimfanelo esibamba ezinombolweni singadluliselwa kuma-matrix njengoba sinjalo yini, yenza isibonelo lapho AB=O kodwa akukho u-A noma B oyi-zero matrix bese uchaza ukuthi kungani usebenzisa isimfanelo sika-A, bese ukhetha izimo lapho isiphetho sibamba khona.
y-m-43-02.material: I-matrix ibhalwa umugqa ngomugqa, futhi okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] i-matrix enomugqa wokuqala 1, 1 nomugqa wesibili 0, 1. E i-identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], futhi O i-zero matrix enawo wonke ama-entry angu-0. Ezinombolweni, uma ab=0 khona a=0 noma b=0. UYerin uthe, 'Ama-matrix nawo anemithetho yokwengeza nokuphindaphinda, ngakho uma AB=O khona A=O noma B=O.' Kulo msebenzi A=[1 2 ; 2 4] imisiwe, futhi A akuyona i-zero matrix.

y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlunga umugqa ngamunye ube yisitatimende ngezinombolo, isitatimende ngama-matrix, noma isiphetho.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thola umugqa ongaba yisisekelo somugqa 3, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi usho into eya ohlangothini olufanayo nomugqa 3 yini.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.0: Ezinombolweni, uma ab=0 khona a=0 noma b=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.1: Ama-matrix nawo anemithetho yokwengeza nokuphindaphinda, njengezinombolo.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho nakuma-matrix, uma AB=O khona A=O noma B=O.

y-m-43-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyisigxobo. Umugqa 1 uyiqiniso elilungile ngezinombolo, futhi umugqa 2 ukhuluma kuphela ukuthi ama-matrix nawo anemithetho, hhayi ukuthi 'ayimithetho efanayo nezinombolo'. Umugqa 4 nawo ulungile, kodwa usho kuphela isiqondiso esisodwa, 'uma A=O khona AB=O'. Lokho umugqa 3 oludingayo isiqondiso esiphambene (uma AB=O khona A=O noma B=O), ngakho umugqa 4 awusekeli umugqa 3. Ukuthi isimfanelo esibamba ezinombolweni sibamba nakuma-matrix kumele kuhlolwe ngokwehlukana.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.prompt: Ku-A=[1 2 ; 2 4], yenza ama-B=[p q ; r s] amabili ahlukene ane-AB=O lapho B ingeyona i-zero matrix. Bese uchaza ngezansi ukuthi kungani i-B enjalo ikhona.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ama-entry amane e-AB ngokuya ku-p, q, r, s, wasethe ngamunye abe ngu-0, bese ubala ukuthi kuphuma izibalo ezingaki ezihlukene.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ngokwehlukana izibalo zekholomu yokuqala (p, r) neyekholomu yesibili (q, s), bese ukhetha amanani azanelisa oyedwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Umugqa wokuqala we-AB une-entry engeyona u-0. Bhala ama-entry omugqa wokuqala ngokuya ku-p, q, r, s.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Umugqa wesibili we-AB nawo wonke ungu-0. Ngakho AB=O.

y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c3: B iyi-zero matrix. Udinga ukuthola i-B engeyona i-zero matrix.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma B=[-2 0 ; 1 0], khona AB=[0 0 ; 0 0]. Akukho A noma B oyi-zero matrix kodwa umkhiqizo uyi-zero matrix, ngakho umugqa 3 kaYerin awubambi. Ukunikeza isibonelo esisodwa kwanele ukuphula 'njalo'. Kulokhu, ama-B angamasikhathi angaguquki omunye komunye (isibonelo [-2 0 ; 1 0] no-[-4 0 ; 2 0]) nawo abalwa njengezibonelo ezihlukile.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ku-B osanda kuyenza, bhala ngomusho owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani AB iba yi-zero matrix, ucaphune isimfanelo esisodwa sika-A.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nge-B owenze ngenhla, bhala inani olithola ngokuphindaphinda umugqa wokuqala ka-A nekholomu yokuqala ka-B bese wengeza.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Beka imigqa emibili ka-A (1, 2 no-2, 4) eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqala ubhale ngomusho owodwa ukuthi inobudlelwano obunjani.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isizathu osibhalile sifinyelela esimfanelweni sika-A (ukuthi i-determinant yayo ingu-0, ukuthi imigqa yayo ilinganayo, njll.), noma uphinde nje wathi 'ngoba AB ingu-O'?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uphindaphinde ngempela i-B eyodwa owenzile ngo-A bese uhlola ngezinombolo ukuthi iba yi-zero matrix?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi i-B efanayo isazosebenza yini uma A ishintsha (isibonelo A=[1 0 ; 0 1])?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.0: I-determinant ka-A ingu-1×4-2×2=0, ngakho ayikho i-inverse matrix. Ngakho uma uthatha ikholomu eyodwa ka-B njengo-(-2, 1), umkhiqizo no-A unikeza u-0, futhi AB=O ingenzeka noma B ingeyona i-zero matrix.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Umugqa wesibili ka-A uyizikhathi ezi-2 zomugqa wokuqala, ngakho uma wenza umugqa owodwa kuphela ube ngu-0, umugqa wesibili uba ngu-0 ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma uthatha ikholomu ka-B njengo-(2, -1), khona 1×2+2×(-1)=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Enye impendulo yesibonelo, echazwe ngobudlelwano obulinganayo bemigqa.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.prompt: Uma A ingeyona i-zero matrix, yisiphi isimo esikuvumela ukuphetha 'uma AB=O khona B=O'?
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula lo A ne-B owayenze esinyathelweni sangaphambilini, bese uhlola oyedwa ngesikhathi ukuthi isimo ngasinye sibamba yini kuleyo A.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qala uchaze ngamagama ukuthi kungani, ezinombolweni, ab=0 no-a≠0 kukuvumela ukusho b=0, usebenzisa 'hlukanisa ngo-a', bese ucabanga ukuthi yini edlala indima yokuhlukanisa kuma-matrix.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.a: Wonke ama-entry ka-A ayizinombolo ezingeyona u-0
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.a: Le A=[1 2 ; 2 4] nayo inawo wonke ama-entry engeyona u-0, kodwa kwakukhona isibonelo lapho B ingeyona i-zero matrix. Uxhumanisa nesibonelo sesinyathelo sangaphambilini, lesi simo asinele.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.b: A^2, isikwele sika-A, nayo ayiyona i-zero matrix
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.b: A^2=[5 10 ; 10 20] nayo ayiyona i-zero matrix, kodwa kwakukhona isibonelo ne-B≠O. Isimo siyafana lapho uthatha amandla ka-A.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.c: Kukhona i-matrix enikeza u-E uma iphindaphindwa no-A
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.d: A i-matrix eyisikwele (2×2) futhi ayiyona i-zero matrix
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.d: Le A nayo yayingu-2×2 futhi kwavela isibonelo esiphikisayo. Usayizi we-matrix awuqinisekisi lesi siphetho.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.explain: Uma A inayo i-inverse matrix A^(-1), ukuphindaphinda u-A^(-1) ngakwesobunxele zezinhlangothi zombili ze-AB=O kunikeza B=O. Lokhu kufana nesimo sokuthi i-determinant ayingu-0. Ngokuphambene, uma i-determinant ingu-0, isibonelo ne-B≠O singavela, njengoba kwenzeke kulokhu.

y-m-43-04.title: Ukukwazi ukubalwa nokuba nencazelo
y-m-43-04.topic: Incazelo yomkhiqizo we-matrix: imigqa namakholomu ethebula lenani nethebula lentengo
y-m-43-04.goal: Hlukanisa lokho okungabalwa lapho amathebula amabili ephindaphindwa nalokho okwenza umphumela ube nencazelo, humusha incazelo yama-entry omphumela, bese uchaza ukuthi i-entry eyodwa yokubala nokulandelana kushintshiwe ibala ini.
y-m-43-04.material: I-matrix ibhalwa umugqa ngomugqa, futhi okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] i-matrix enomugqa wokuqala 1, 1 nomugqa wesibili 0, 1. E i-identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], futhi O i-zero matrix enawo wonke ama-entry angu-0. Esikoleni, iKilasi 1 neKilasi 2 bathenga isinkwa nobisi njengokudla okulula. Ithebula lenani N linemigqa yamakilasi (umugqa wokuqala iKilasi 1, umugqa wesibili iKilasi 2) namakholomu ezinto (ikholomu yokuqala isinkwa, ikholomu yesibili ubisi): N=[3 2 ; 1 4]. (IKilasi 1 lithenga izinkwa ezi-3 nobisi obuyi-2, iKilasi 2 lithenga isinkwa esi-1 nobisi obu-4.) Ithebula lentengo P linemigqa yezinto (umugqa wokuqala isinkwa, umugqa wesibili ubisi) namakholomu ezitolo (ikholomu yokuqala isitolo X, ikholomu yesibili isitolo Y): P=[1500 1800 ; 1000 1200]. (Iyunithi ngu-won. Esitolo X, isinkwa singu-1500 won nobisi bungu-1000 won / esitolo Y, isinkwa singu-1800 won nobisi bungu-1200 won.) Bafuna ukuthola izindleko eziphelele zekilasi ngalinye nesitolo ngasinye. UJiho uthe, 'Phindaphinda nje u-N no-P ngalokho kulandelana,' futhi uSeoa uthe, 'Kokubili kungu-2×2, ngakho ukuphindaphinda u-P no-N nakho kungabalwa, ngakho ukulandelana akunandaba.'

y-m-43-05.title: Ukuqoqa ama-matrix aba yi-identity matrix lapho enziwa isikwele
y-m-43-05.topic: Ama-matrix anelisa u-A^2=E nezimfanelo zawo ezivamile
y-m-43-05.goal: Qinisekisa ngokwenza izibonelo ukuthi izixazululo ze-x^2=1 ezinombolweni, ezimbili kuphela, ziningi kakhulu kuma-matrix, thola futhi uhlunge izimfanelo ezivamile phakathi kwezibonelo ozenzile, bese uchaza ngokubala ukuthi kungani lokhu kuhlukile ezinombolweni.
y-m-43-05.material: I-matrix ibhalwa umugqa ngomugqa, futhi okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] i-matrix enomugqa wokuqala 1, 1 nomugqa wesibili 0, 1. E i-identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], futhi O i-zero matrix enawo wonke ama-entry angu-0. Kunombolo x, uma x^2=1 khona x=1 noma x=-1. Kwi-matrix engu-2×2 A=[a b ; c d], thola u-A anelisa u-A^2=E. Ama-entry akudingeki abe yizinombolo eziphelele, kodwa uma ulinganisela inani lempande eyisikwele ngedesimali, impendulo elungile ingaphuma njengengalungile, ngakho kungcono ukusebenzisa izinombolo eziphelele noma izinombolo eziphuma ncamashi, njengo-0.6 no-0.8. y-m-43-06.goal: Hlola umthetho jikelele othatha ipheya elenzeke ukusebenza njengobufakazi bokuthi lisebenza, yenza omatriksi lapho ifomula iphuka khona futhi uhlole ukuthi iphuka ngaphansi kwesimo sini, futhi ubhale ukuphikisa okusekelwe kuleso siphumo.
y-m-43-06.material: Imatriksi ibhalwa umugqa nomugqa, futhi lokho okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, u-[1 1 ; 0 1] uyimatriksi enomugqa wokuqala u-1, 1 nomugqa wesibili u-0, 1. U-E uyimatriksi ye-identity u-[1 0 ; 0 1], futhi u-O uyimatriksi ewuziro enawo wonke amalungu angu-0. I-determinant yematriksi engu-2×2 u-M=[a b ; c d] ibhalwa u-|M|=ad-bc. UDoyun wathi, 'I-determinant yesamu lomatriksi ababili ilingana nesamu lama-determinant abo. Okungukuthi, u-|A+B|=|A|+|B|.' Njengobufakazi, wahlola u-A=[1 0 ; 0 0] no-B=[0 1 ; 1 0], futhi u-|A+B|=|[1 1 ; 1 0]|=-1 no-|A|+|B|=0+(-1)=-1, kwalingana.

y-m-43-10.title: Ukwenza isihluthulelo sokuhlehlisa amanothi ezinombolo ezigcwele

y-m-43-10.material: I-matrix ibhalwa umugqa ngomugqa, futhi okuphambi kwephoyinti elinekhoma (;) kungumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] i-matrix enomugqa wokuqala 1, 1 nomugqa wesibili 0, 1. E iyi-identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], futhi O iyi-matrix ka-zero enamanani onke angu-0. Izinombolo ezigcwele ezimbili (x, y) zithathwa njenge-column vector [x ; y], futhi i-matrix yesihluthulelo K=[a b ; c d] eyaphindaphindwa ngakwesobunxele, [ax+by ; cx+dy], ithunyelwa njengenothi. Uhlangothi olwamukelayo yidivayisi engabala kuphela izinombolo ezigcwele, ngakho iphindaphinda i-matrix ephambene ye-K enothini ukubuyisela u-(x, y) wokuqala, kodwa ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa uma amanani e-matrix ephambene enezingxenyana. Ifomula ye-matrix ephambene: uma ad-bc≠0, khona-ke K^(-1) = (1/(ad-bc)) · [d -b ; -c a].

y-m-43-08.topic: Ukuhamba kwamakhasimende phakathi kwama-cafe amabili: imatriksi yokuguquka nesibikezelo seviki lezinsuku ezimbili ngaphambili
y-m-43-08.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni esisebenzise umthetho wokuhamba kwansuku zonke obhalwe ngematriksi kabili, yakha izimo eziningana zokuqala ngaphakathi kobubanzi obunelisa izimo, futhi ubikezele ushintsho uma umthetho uqhubeka.
y-m-43-08.material: Imatriksi ibhalwa umugqa nomugqa, futhi lokho okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, u-[1 1 ; 0 1] uyimatriksi enomugqa wokuqala u-1, 1 nomugqa wesibili u-0, 1. U-E uyimatriksi ye-identity u-[1 0 ; 0 1], futhi u-O uyimatriksi ewuziro enawo wonke amalungu angu-0. Cabanga ukuthi amakhasimende asebenzisa ama-cafe amabili 가 no-나 endaweni ahlanganisa u-1000 usuku ngalunye, futhi akekho omusha oza noma oshiya. Usuku ngalunye, u-80% wamakhasimende luka-가 ahamba aye ku-가 futhi ngolunye usuku futhi u-20% ahambela ku-나, futhi u-90% wamakhasimende luka-나 ahamba aye ku-나 ngolunye usuku futhi u-10% ahambela ku-가. Lezi zilinganiso ziyafana nsuku zonke, futhi noma inani labantu liphuma njenge-decimal, ligcine njengoba linjalo ekubaleni. Bhala isimo njengo-X=[inani lamakhasimende ku-가 ; inani lamakhasimende ku-나], futhi isimo sosuku olulandelayo ngu-M=[0.8 0.1 ; 0.2 0.9] luphindaphindwe ngo-X. y-m-43-03.goal: Nquma ukuthi yini odinga ukuyazi ukuhlehlisa umphumela wokwenza ukuguqulwa okubili ngokulandelana, khetha i-matrix ebuyisayo, bese uthola ngqo amaphoyinti lapho umphumela ufana noma ukulandelana kushintshwa.
y-m-43-03.material: I-matrix ibhalwa umugqa ngomugqa, futhi okungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumugqa wokuqala. Isibonelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] i-matrix enomugqa wokuqala 1, 1 nomugqa wesibili 0, 1. E i-identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], futhi O i-zero matrix enawo wonke ama-entry angu-0. Iphoyinti (x, y) libhalwa njenge-column vector [x ; y], futhi i-matrix iphindaphindwa kusuka ngakwesobunxele ukuhambisa iphoyinti. I-matrix A=[1 1 ; 0 1] ihambisa iphoyinti (x, y) liye ku-(x+y, y), futhi B=[2 0 ; 0 1] ihambisa iphoyinti (x, y) liye ku-(2x, y). A no-B bobabili banama-inverse matrix. A no-B basetshenziswa kanye ngamunye, ngokulandelana okuthile, ngokulandelana, kuphoyinti elithile. Siyakwazi kuphela iphoyinti elivelayo futhi sifuna ukubuyisela iphoyinti lokuqala. I-inverse matrix ka-A ibhalwa A^(-1), futhi i-inverse matrix ka-B ibhalwa B^(-1).

y-m-43-03.s.s1.explain: Indlela yokuhlehlisa incike ku-'kwenziwe kuqala ini'. Uma usebenzisa u-A kuqala bese u-B ephoyintini (1, 2), liba ngu-(6, 2), futhi uma usebenzisa u-B kuqala bese u-A, liba ngu-(4, 2). Imiphumela ihlukile, ngakho indlela yokuhlehlisa ayikwazi ukufana. Amanani ephoyinti akadingeki ukunquma i-matrix ehlehlisayo.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.prompt: Manje uyazi ukuthi 'u-A wenziwe kuqala bese u-B'. Iyiphi i-matrix enikeza iphoyinti lokuqala uma iphindaphindwa kuphoyinti elivelayo?
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.0: Iphoyinti lokuqala (1, 2) laba ngu-(6, 2) nge-A bese B. Sebenzisa umuntu ngamunye oqokelwayo kule (6, 2) bese uhlola ukuthi (1, 2) liyabuya yini.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.1: Uma umkhiqizo wama-matrix usetshenziswa kuphoyinti, nquma ukuthi i-matrix yesokudla noma yesobunxele isetshenziswa kuqala, bese uyifanisa nokuthi iyiphi i-matrix eyayiyikuguqulwa kokugcina.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.a: Uma uphindaphinda umkhiqizo we-matrix B^(-1)A^(-1) kuphoyinti, yesokudla, A^(-1), isetshenziswa kuqala. Qhathanisa lokhu nokulandelana lapho uhlehlisa uqala ekuguqulweni kokugcina.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.b: I-matrix eyengeza ukuhlehlisa okubili ayihlehlisi iphoyinti kabili kodwa yengeza imiphumela emibili. Ukusebenzisa ngokulandelana nokwengeza kuyizinto ezihlukile.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.c: I-inverse matrix ka-A+B akuyona i-inverse yokusebenzisa u-A no-B ngokulandelana. Isamba siyisenzo esihlukile ekwenzeni oyedwa ngemva komunye.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.explain: Uma iphoyinti lihanjiswa ngo-A bese u-B, iphoyinti elivelayo ngu-B(A x) (iphoyinti lokuqala x liphindaphindwa kuqala ngo-A bese lowo mphumela uphindaphindwa ngo-B). Ukuze uhlehlise, kumele uqale uhlehlise ongaphambi kokugcina, u-B (B^(-1)), bese uhlehlisa u-A (A^(-1)). Lapho uphindaphinda ama-matrix, i-matrix yesokudla isetshenziswa kuqala, ngakho ngu-A^(-1)B^(-1). Isibonelo: lapho iphoyinti lokuqala (1, 2) laba ngu-(6, 2), B^(-1) inikeza u-(3, 2) futhi u-A^(-1) ubuyisela u-(1, 2).
y-m-43-03.s.s3.prompt: Ingabe likhona iphoyinti lapho umphumela ufana noma ukulandelana kuyini? Thola futhi ufake amaphoyinti amabili ahlukene eziphelele (x, y), angeyona umsuka, lapho 'umphumela wokwenza u-A kuqala bese u-B' no-'umphumela wokwenza u-B kuqala bese u-A' kufana.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngokuya ku-x no-y izixhumanisi zephoyinti elitholwe ngokusebenzisa u-A kuqala bese u-B ephoyintini (x, y). Bhala icala lapho u-B enziwa kuqala ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.1: Uma ulinganisa izixhumanisi zokuqala zamaphoyinti amabili, bheka ukuthi yimuphi ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-x no-y obusalile.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Liphoyinti elinezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele futhi x ayiyona u-0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Sicela ulenze libe yiphoyinti elinezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele no-x ongeyona u-0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Imiphumela yokulandelana okubili iyafana. (Isixhumanisi sokuqala siyafana, futhi isixhumanisi sesibili sihlala singu-y.)
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Imiphumela yokulandelana okubili iyahluka. Bhala umphumela we-A kuqala bese B nomphumela we-B kuqala bese A ngamunye njengo-(x, y) bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.explain: Uma wenza u-A kuqala bese u-B, (x, y) lidlula ku-(x+y, y) futhi libe ngu-(2x+2y, y). Uma wenza u-B kuqala bese u-A, lidlula ku-(2x, y) futhi libe ngu-(2x+y, y). Ukuze izixhumanisi zokuqala zilingane, 2y=y, okungukuthi, y=0. Ngakho ukulandelana akunandaba kuphela kumaphoyinti asex-axis, futhi kwamanye amaphoyinti ukulandelana kushintsha umphumela.
